subject: Sandbox PO stub assignment & line-item pruning for Solstice Labs onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@solstice-labs.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.example, procure@redwood.example
Cc: Karen Liu <karen@solstice-labs.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Solstice onboarding – initial PO request and form

Hi Grace / Procurement team,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning — attaching our completed onboarding form (Solstice_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf) and a simple line-item table. We noticed the account creation flow requires a provisional purchase serial / PO stub so we can start the integration while the legal DocuSign is routing.

Can you: 
- Issue a provisional PO stub we can reference in our internal billing (+ indicate provisional spend cap)
- Confirm if you need any more SKU-level detail — the onboarding form has a couple of ambiguous lines (item 2 SKU listed as S-120 but should probably be S-210)

Target start date for calls & test traffic is next week (May 3). If you can get a provisional PO and cap in the next 48 hours that would keep timelines intact.

Attachments: Solstice_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf (PDF), LineItem_Breakdown.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Partnerships
Solstice Labs

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example>

Cc: Elena Torres <elena@solstice-labs.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Solstice onboarding – initial PO request and form

David / Monica — forwarding Solstice's form. Quick asks: 
- David, can you assign a provisional PO stub we can hand to the vendor so they can begin integration? Provisional cap request is currently $40k but leave room to bump if they finalize a larger quantity.
- Monica, can you confirm the process for moving a provisional cap to final once DocuSign completes? Also we need to reconcile the SKU mismatch Elena called out (S-120 vs S-210).

Timeline: Elena wants a provisional PO within 48 hrs to meet their May 3 test start. If you need to escalate to ProcureOps for a temporary spend override, please call it out and loop me.

Thanks — Grace
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
